mechanics.title: Tooltips
mechanics.description: Food tooltips show hunger and saturation values (hold Shift unless 'always show' is enabled).

mechanics.title: HUD overlays
mechanics.description: Shows hunger and saturation that held food would restore (also for off-hand food), estimated health restored, a saturation overlay on the hunger bar, and an exhaustion bar behind it.

mechanics.title: Debug screen
mechanics.description: Hunger, saturation and exhaustion appear in the F3 screen.

qol: Reveals otherwise hidden saturation and exhaustion mechanics; it does not change any mechanics.
getting_started: Hold food to see the preview on your hunger bar; hold Shift over food in an inventory to see numbers.
editor_notes: Needs to be on the server for accurate saturation/exhaustion values; this pack has it on both.
name: AppleSkin
summary: Adds food-related information to the HUD and tooltips. You can see how much hunger and saturation a food restores, your hidden saturation and exhaustion levels, and the health food would restore.
